diagnosis: The patient portal SSR route retrieves medical records by recordId and hydrates a shared global Zustand store without verifying that req.user.patientId matches the medical record's patient. The rendered HTML preloads diagnoses and lab summaries from the shared store into the client browser. Any patient can view psychiatric evaluations, infectious disease diagnoses, and lab histories of other patients.
